description: Mazada wears an opaque pale cream and gold floor-length court gown with a low square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Gold and charcoal geometric woven borders outline the neckline, bodice sides, cuffs, waist, long front skirt panel and hem. A broad decorated waistband bears two round gold-toned ornaments and a hanging central strap. A soft golden-brown wrap with fringed ends rests around her forearms and descends alongside the skirt. Small gold-toned drop earrings, a bracelet and modest rings add subtle ornament. Brown embroidered flat shoes show through the lower-front opening. Her close black curls are uncovered.
